title: The verification format, version 1
description: The result of checking a work item's acceptance criteria against one version of its work: the file of a version of a structured artifact type. matrix has one row for each criterion that was checked, and not_verified lists each criterion that was not, with the reason. A criterion is in matrix or in not_verified, never in both, which a JSON Schema cannot check. The ids are the criterion ids of acceptance-criteria.schema.json, and each is one of the ids in the newest version of the acceptance criteria, which a JSON Schema cannot check either. The file's size limit is the artifact type's, which a JSON Schema cannot check. No object has a member this schema does not define.

target_version.description: The exact version of the target that the verification checked, never a name that can later point to another version. For a repository, a commit. The grammar is generic, because a target in another system has another kind of version: 1 to 255 letters, digits and the characters ._/-.

matrix.description: One row for each criterion that was checked, in the order of the criteria: empty when no criterion was checked.

not_verified.description: Each criterion that was not checked, with the reason: empty when every criterion was checked.

model_families.description: The families of the models that checked the criteria, such as the names of their makers: at least one, each 1 to 64 characters on one line, none twice.

row.description: The result for one criterion that was checked.

criterion.description: The id of the criterion: ac- and a number from 1 to 9999 with no leading zero, such as ac-3.

state.description: met when the check shows that the criterion is met, not_met when the check shows that it is not.

evidence.description: What the check found, in plain text: what was looked at or run, and the result.

not_verified.description: A criterion that was not checked, and why.

criterion.description: The id of the criterion: ac- and a number from 1 to 9999 with no leading zero, such as ac-3.

reason.description: Why the criterion was not checked, in plain text.

criterion_id.description: A criterion's id: ac- and a number from 1 to 9999 with no leading zero, such as ac-3.

text.description: Text that may span lines. Tab, line feed and carriage return are its only control characters: it has none of U+0000 to U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F. It has none of the bidirectional controls, the marks U+061C, U+200E and U+200F, the embeddings and overrides U+202A to U+202E and the isolates U+2066 to U+2069; the separators U+2028 and U+2029; and the format characters U+00AD, U+180E, U+200B, U+2060 to U+2064, U+FEFF and U+FFF9 to U+FFFB.

line.description: Text on one line: text as $defs text defines it, with no control character at all, so no tab, line feed or carriage return.
